WASHINGTON
By virtue of the authority vested in  
me as President of the United States, it  
is ordered that Executive Order No. 2123  
of January 20, 1915, reserving certain  
public land in the State of Washington  
as a refuge, preserve and breeding  
ground for native birds, known as  
Dungeness Spit Reservation, be, and the  
same is hereby, modified to the extent  
necessary to permit the Navy Depart­
ment to have primary jurisdiction over
the following-described land for naval
